speaker: abel_garnish
text: Twenty-three rolls. Six days. I carried the basket myself, and nobody else has had a hand in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Six days, twenty-three. They stay on this table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will read it through. Every voice. Peter I will read flat, when I come to him.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The table is long and the fire is lit. Read. The yard is not yours this morning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The feast is sixteen bars. I will not teach it again before the parts are out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen. This is a reading. It is not a playing.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The boy marks his roll when he has it. Nobody startles him, and nobody asks him to prove a part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody asks him. I am not giving him a question to fail.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Peter is short, and he is clean. I copied what you wrote. I did not help him.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Begin at the beginning. I will not have the nurse before her time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The town first. Then the quarrel. Then the feast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This is her first speech. I have it flat, the way I had Peter.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Stop. I have heard enough of your nurse to know she is not yours.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I've dandled worse. Give me the child and a cushion for my bosom.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Take the cushion. If you drop my chair I will have it back before the speech is done.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: She was weaned on a day the earth moved. And she fell backward. A napkin on the head, or it is only a man sitting down.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tom. The book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The book can wait the length of a prayer.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: There she is. Mab. I smiled at the fire like a fool, and I have her again.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Breathe, James. I have wept into the reckoning-book, and I have struck you on the back.

speaker: james_burbage
text: You have struck me like a choked horse. I am living. Let him finish the fall.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The fall is finished. The napkin stays until I am done remembering.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She is yours. I will not read her again unless you give her back.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Dick has not said a word since the cushion. Leave him.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then leave him. I have the nurse.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The reckoning-book is wet. There is no sum in it worth a tear. Go on. Not the nurse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On. Peter is still a board when I come back to him. The nurse stays where Tom put her.
